_comment: agent.json is now OPTIONAL. The coordinator URL + token are baked into simagent.exe at build time, and the agent auto-detects its identity (pc_ip + folder) from the coordinator via /whoami. Just drop simagent.exe on a PC and run it — no config file needed.
_overrides: Only create agent.json if you need to override something below. Any field left out is auto-filled (baked default / /whoami / sane default).
_pc_ip: force a specific identity instead of the IP the coordinator sees (rarely needed)
_coordinator_url: override the baked-in coordinator, e.g. http://70.84.68.196:8090
_enforce_on_start: sync training-live + launch apps on boot (default true); set false for a passive/testing agent
